TIME released the 2026 TIME100 AI list on August 27, featuring top AI leaders across research and industry, with focus shifting to applications and agent ecosystems.

The list covers LLM architectures, compute hardware, humanoid robotics, data centers, AI agents, and AI safety.
Key executives and researchers included: Leaders across top computing labs; Innovators across frontier model startups and robotics; Thinkers including Fei-Fei Li (World Labs), Mira Murati (Thinking Machines Lab), and others.
